overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board did not deliberate outside a posted meeting, and the law does not require discussing any particular topic. Review was limited to three open meetings.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board must have secretly deliberated about a landfill litigation matter because it was not discussed in open session across many meetings from December 2017 to November 2018.
allegations.key_passage: Absent sufficient evidence to the contrary, we credit the Board’s account of the facts and find that it did not have any private discussions outside of a noticed meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant argued the Board's failure to list or discuss the landfill litigation matter at its meetings showed improper handling of that topic under the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require a public body to discuss any topic.

allegations.summary: Complaint was filed with the Board within 30 days only for certain meetings, so the AG limited its review to the October 30, November 14, and November 20, 2018 open meetings.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we limit our review to Board meetings held on October 30, 2018; November 14, 2018; and November 20, 2018.
